subtitle.heading: Foreign Shipping Practices

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This subtitle may be cited as the “Foreign Shipping Practices Act of 1988”.

subtitle.editorialNote: [Section 10002 repealed by section 19 of Public Law 109–304.]

subsection.content: Amends section 212(B)(c) of the Merchant Marine Act, 1936.]

For one year after the date of enactment of this Act, a vessel that is undergoing repair or retrofitting for use solely for mobile trade fair purposes is deemed to be out of commission under section 3302(e) of title 46, United States Code, during the repair or retrofitting.
